newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Motor May vehicle sales up to 86,810 units.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Motor May vehicle sales up to 86,810 units.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Monday its vehicle sales in May rose to 86,810 units compared with 72,586 a year earlier.
Daewoo's vehicle exports in the month reached 53,565 units, up from 43,865 a year before, the company said.
"Shipments of new model cars contributed to the export rise in May," a Daewoo Motor spokesman said.
Daewoo has introduced three new models -- Lanos sub-compact cars, Nubira compact and Leganza medium-sized sedans since last November.
The company's domestic sales increased to 33,245 units in May, up from 28,721 units a year ago, but were lower than April's 42,351 units.
"Sales competition in the domestic market became more intense in May. Slumping domestic demand was also to blame," the spokesman said.
